summary: As of November 2026, commercial LLM API pricing spans a roughly 100x range, from budget models near $0.10-$0.30 per million input tokens to flagship models at $5-$15 per million input tokens and up to $30+ per million output tokens. Vendors increasingly price by task tier rather than by brand, with prompt caching, batch discounts, and tiered pricing (based on context length) now standard. Output tokens remain significantly more expensive than input tokens, and several providers offer free tiers or trial credits for developers.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers ~50% discount. Prompt caching halves input cost on repeated context. Pricing via official API.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost small model. Batch API ~50% discount. Prompt caching available.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching read cost ~10% of base input; cache writes priced separately. Batch API offers 50% discount. Long-context tier pricing may apply above 200K tokens.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Text/image/video input $0.30; audio input $1.00. Free tier available via Google AI Studio. Context caching offered at reduced rates.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Tiered pricing: $1.25 input / $10 output for ≤200K tokens, rising to $2.50 / $15 above 200K. Free tier via Google AI Studio.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model. Output includes reasoning tokens. Batch and caching discounts available.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Flagship reasoning model (price reduced from launch). Output includes reasoning tokens. Batch and caching discounts available.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast, low-cost model. Prompt caching read ~$0.10/1M. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Highest-capability Anthropic model. Prompt caching and batch (50%) discounts significantly reduce cost for repeated workloads.

models.name: Grok 4
models.notes: Available via xAI API. Cached input priced at a discount. Higher rates may apply for extended context.

models.name: DeepSeek V3.2
models.notes: Very low cost with aggressive cache-hit pricing. Off-peak discounts available.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Flagship Mistral model via La Plateforme. Free tier available for experimentation with rate limits.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Cost-efficient small model. Free tier available via La Plateforme with rate limits.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Together AI)
models.notes: Price varies by Llama model size (e.g. Llama 3.3 70B ~$0.88/1M). Serverless inference; dedicated endpoints also available. Free trial credits offered.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Groq)
models.notes: High-throughput LPU inference. Pricing varies by model (e.g. Llama 3.3 70B). Free tier with rate limits.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Fireworks AI)
models.notes: Serverless pricing varies by model parameter tier. Dedicated deployments available. Free trial credits offered.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Optimized for RAG and tool use. Free trial API keys available with rate limits; production keys billed per token.
